verdict.rationale: Auth0's first-party docs describe Organizations for modeling multiple B2B customers in a single tenant, with per-organization branding, connections, and members. They also cover membership management, the My Organization API, and embeddable admin components for customer self-service, plus self-service SSO and SCIM directory sync for enterprise clients. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of invitation flows (inviting users into an organization), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Organizations feature.
